implementation: Authenticated active-account Google Text Search and Place Details adapter; explicit client/server enable flags and server-only API key. Caller-supplied GPS/auth/account fields are not forwarded. Place Details fetches coordinates then calls service-role-only trusted cache writer.

Actual Host search selection stores source=google and Google place ID. HostDraft serialization, restoration and edit hydration retain only those identifiers for Google venues. Labels, addresses, coordinates and attributions cannot enter durable drafts.

Activity writes refresh Place Details before publishing/updating a selected Google venue. API payloads strip Google labels/coordinates; DB trigger binds the trusted receipt and stores only a static Google Maps venue label plus source/ID.

Transient names, addresses and required Google Maps/third-party attributions render only inside the disposable GoogleVenue component. Resolution aborts on unmount; account changes discard stale responses. Google content is never placed into canonical Activity.where/locationName/AppData fields.

All production/workspace/Home Activity mappers retain source/placeID/expiry and mask expired coordinates. Both Home and Activities Nearby paths reject expired coordinates; server Nearby queries include the expiry predicate. A bounded timer clears expired coordinates from memory-only AppData during long-running sessions.

Google Activity map actions use Google Maps PlaceID links. Internal shares and SOS text use PlaceID links plus user-authored instructions, never resolved provider addresses. Existing non-Google map/link behavior is unchanged.
Existing OSM/legacy venue selection remains functional without Google configuration. Empty, disabled/unavailable, error, retry and current-location paths preserve truthful provider labels.
Separate SQL slice: durable source/PlaceID plus private28-day trusted coordinate cache; service-only writer, source-change guards, stale masking and hourly purge. No provider refreshes run from Cron.
